* AI Certifications & Relevant Project Experiences.

* Proven leadership in end-to-end Data transformations and enterprise-scale data platforms across multiple countries and verticals.
* Deep hands-on expertise in Azure Data Services, Databricks, Informatica, Snowflake and GCP, with strong command of data engineering, cloud architecture and AI/ML model lifecycle.

* Experience orchestrating global, matrixed deal structuring teams across TCO, multi-tower, digital, consulting and managed services deal types.

The ideal candidate should have proven experience in logistics sales, freight forwarding, transportation, and supply chain solutions, with the ability to generate and manage business opportunities worth a minimum of **₹1–5 Crore in annual business revenue**.

The candidate must have a proven track record of meeting clients, pitching marketing solutions, negotiating commercial terms, and successfully closing business deals.

This is not a conventional sales position. We expect the candidate to understand a client's business, identify growth opportunities, conceptualise marketing strategies, and integrate multiple advertising mediums into comprehensive solutions.

The individual should be capable of independently handling the entire business development cycle, from prospecting and client meetings to strategic pitching, negotiations, and final closures.

**We are looking for someone who can think like a marketer, strategise like a consultant, and close like a business leader.**

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Development & Client Acquisition

* Identify, prospect, and acquire new business opportunities across industries.
* Develop relationships with business owners, CXOs, marketing heads, brand managers, and senior decision-makers.
* Independently schedule and conduct face-to-face and virtual client meetings.
* Understand client requirements, business objectives, marketing challenges, and growth ambitions.
* Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline through networking, referrals, industry research, and direct client engagement.
* Take ownership of opportunities from initial contact through proposal presentation, negotiation, and closure.
* Consistently achieve assigned revenue and client acquisition targets.
* Develop long-term client relationships to generate repeat business and account growth.

2. Strategic Marketing Ideation & Consultation

* Understand the client's business model, target audience, competitive landscape, and market positioning.
* Identify business challenges and translate them into relevant marketing and advertising opportunities.
* Conceptualise creative marketing strategies and integrated campaign ideas based on client objectives.
* Recommend innovative solutions to improve brand visibility, customer acquisition, retail footfalls, and business growth.
* Demonstrate the ability to intellectually engage clients and communicate the business rationale behind proposed marketing strategies.
* Work with internal creative, digital, and media teams to develop customised marketing solutions.
* Present ideas that connect marketing investments with measurable business outcomes.

3. Integrated Media Planning & Solution Selling

* Possess a strong understanding of multiple advertising and marketing mediums.
* Conceptualise and pitch integrated marketing solutions rather than selling individual advertising services.
* Understand how different media channels complement each other to achieve campaign objectives.
* Recommend appropriate media combinations based on client budgets, target audiences, geography, and business objectives.

**Digital Media**

* Meta Advertising (Facebook & Instagram)
* Google Ads and YouTube Advertising
* Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)
* Influencer Marketing
* Social Media Marketing
* Performance Marketing
* Website Development and Digital Strategy

**Traditional & Mainstream Media**

* Television Advertising
* Radio Advertising
* Newspaper and Print Advertising
* Outdoor Advertising (OOH)
* Cinema Advertising
* Transit and Airport Advertising

**Creative & Emerging Media**

* Brand Films and Commercial Production
* AI-Powered Video Advertising
* Content Marketing
* Experiential Marketing
* Retail and In-store Advertising
* Integrated Brand Campaigns

The candidate should be capable of combining multiple mediums into a cohesive advertising strategy rather than approaching each service as an independent offering.

4. Client Meetings, Pitching & Deal Closures

* Independently conduct client meetings and lead business discussions.
* Present marketing strategies, campaign concepts, media plans, and commercial proposals.
* Confidently articulate the value proposition of Brandtom and Brandter.
* Handle client objections, negotiate pricing, and identify mutually beneficial commercial arrangements.
* Demonstrate strong presentation, persuasion, and consultative selling abilities.
* Understand client budgets and recommend commercially viable solutions.
* Take ownership of negotiations and drive opportunities towards successful closure.
* Convert one-time projects into long-term retainers and integrated marketing partnerships.
* Build relationships that generate referrals and recurring business.

5. Proposal Development & Internal Coordination

* Prepare business proposals, pitch presentations, and marketing recommendations in coordination with internal teams.
* Work closely with creative strategists, designers, media planners, and digital marketing specialists.

The role identifies needs, sets priorities and brings together the right local/school and specialist capability to deliver the strongest business outcome.

Successful candidates will **think like a business owner** (not just a marketer), communicate clearly, take ownership of outcomes, prioritise effectively across multiple schools, and balance strategy with execution.

title: Senior Research Associate II
description:
Overview:

**Overview:**

The Senior Research Associate independently develops renovation and innovation products from formulation and laboratory evaluation through application validation, factory trials, scale-up, and transfer to manufacturing. This hands-on role requires regular work in Kemin and external laboratories and the ability to plan and execute factory trials at Kemin’s manufacturing facility. The role serves as the product owner for assigned products from concept to launch.

Responsibilities:

**Lead Renovation and Innovation Projects**

* Lead assigned renovation and innovation projects, or defined R&D workstreams within larger projects, from technical brief through formulation, laboratory evaluation, application validation, factory trials, scale-up, manufacturing transfer, and technical launch readiness.
* Define the technical scope, hypotheses, Critical to Quality requirements, success criteria, milestones, risks, resources, and deliverables with the project sponsor and relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain current project plans and communicate progress, technical decisions, dependencies, risks, delays, and recovery actions before milestones are missed.
* Remain accountable for assigned technical deliverables until agreed acceptance criteria are achieved, required documentation is completed, and outstanding technical issues are formally transferred to the accountable function Perform Hands-On Laboratory and Application Work.
* Spend significant working time conducting experiments and application trials in Kemin laboratories and, when required, at external laboratories, customer facilities, partner facilities, and manufacturing sites.
* Independently formulate prototypes and conduct efficacy, stability, analytical, application-performance, and product-packaging compatibility evaluations.
* Design and execute robust experiments using appropriate controls, replication, statistical methods, and predefined acceptance criteria.
* Maintain complete and traceable records of protocols, raw data, observations, deviations, results, conclusions, and recommendations.
* Ensure laboratory, pilot, and production experiments are documented in accordance with applicable procedures and PIP requirements. The PIP Manual requires these experiments to be recorded in laboratory notebooks and white paper Plan and Run Manufacturing Trials.
* Independently plan, coordinate, and lead on-site factory trials at Kemin’s Gummidipoondi manufacturing facility.
* Establish trial objectives, protocols, material requirements, process parameters, sampling plans, Critical to Quality measures, and acceptance criteria before each trial.
* Work on-site with Operations, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Engineering, and other relevant functions during trial execution.
* Lead technical troubleshooting, collect and analyze trial data, document conclusions, and ensure agreed follow-up actions are completed.

  

* Recommend whether a product is ready for reformulation, further testing, repeat trials, scale-up, manufacturing transfer, or technical launch readiness.

**Manage R&D Deliverables within PIP**

* Serve as the R&D Project Manager for assigned projects, working collaboratively with the Product Manager and the wider Product Innovation Process team.
* Develop and maintain the research plan and ensure assigned R&D activities and documentation are completed according to the applicable PIP stage and agreed schedule. • Provide complete and timely technical data, white papers, trial reports, risk assessments, Critical to Quality evidence, packaging recommendations, and manufacturing-transfer information for PIP reviews and gate decisions.
* Proactively identify technical gaps, coordinate actions with relevant functions, and resolve outstanding requirements before requesting progression to the next PIP stage.
* Maintain accurate PIP documentation in the designated company project-management system.
* Support scale-up, launch, and post-launch technical follow-up, including additional efficacy, stability, quality, application, or manufacturing work when required.

**Generate Reliable Data and Technical Recommendations**

* Collect, analyze, interpret, and document research and trial data independently, ensuring traceability from raw data to conclusion.
* Apply fit-for-purpose analytical and application methods and confirm that instruments, standards, controls, and methods are suitable for use.
* Review data generated by interns/trainees, identify gaps, and determine whether additional work is required.
* Convert findings into clear recommendations on formulation, efficacy, stability, application performance, packaging, manufacturing feasibility, technical risks, and next steps.
* Use appropriate statistical methods and approved digital and AI-enabled tools to identify trends and improve the speed and quality of technical analysis and decision support.
* Apply independent scientific judgment when reviewing AI-assisted outputs and verify the accuracy, relevance, and reliability of information before use.

**Evaluate and Recommend Packaging**

* Evaluate and recommend appropriate packaging formats, materials, pack sizes, and technical specifications based on product compatibility, stability, customer application, storage, transportation, regulatory requirements, cost, and manufacturing capability.
* Plan and execute packaging compatibility and stability studies, and coordinate packaging trials when required.

* Coordinate approved project activities assigned to interns or junior colleagues and review their technical outputs promptly.

* Develop and improve methods, templates, protocols, and working practices that strengthen scientific quality, execution speed, consistency, and knowledge retention.
* Promote responsible and effective use of approved statistical, digital, and AI tools within the R&D team.

* Apply 5S principles and maintain a safe, organized, and inspection-ready working environment.
* Ensure equipment readiness and coordinate calibration, preventive maintenance, repairs, inventory, and material availability.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, research protocols, analytical and application methods, risk assessments, and safety procedures within the role’s authority.
* Report safety, quality, equipment, cybersecurity, confidentiality, or data-integrity concerns promptly and ensure agreed corrective actions are completed.

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant scientific or engineering discipline.
* Strong laboratory, experimental design, data analysis, and basic statistical skills.
* Scientific curiosity, practical problem-solving, and an interest in renovation and innovation.
* Organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to prioritize and deliver assigned projects.
* Able to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and comfortable using approved AI and digital tools to support research and productivity.
* Willing to conduct hands-on work in laboratories and manufacturing facilities.

title: Manager – Marketing Technology /Braze
description:
About This Role

**10 to 12 years of experience**  
**Skills: Manager – Marketing Technology / Braze**

**Job Description:** Manager – Marketing Technology / Braze

**Experience:** 10+ years
  
**Primary Platform:** Braze
  
**Secondary Platforms:** Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) / Bird
  
**Domain:** Financial Services / Banking / FinTech
  
**Team Size:** 10+ members
  
**Channels:** Email, SMS, Mobile App / Push and cross-channel customer journeys

**Role Summary:**  
We are looking for an experienced Manager – Marketing Technology with 10+ years of experience in marketing automation, campaign management and customer journey orchestration, with strong recent hands-on experience in Braze.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience designing, building and optimizing sophisticated cross-channel campaigns and customer journeys across Email, SMS and Mobile App/Push channels. The role requires a combination of strong MarTech platform expertise, campaign strategy, technical solutioning, people management and client-facing leadership.

The candidate will lead a 10+ member MarTech/campaign operations team, work directly with client stakeholders, translate business and marketing requirements into scalable campaign solutions, and ensure high-quality delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**
  
1. Braze & Marketing Technology Leadership
  

* Serve as the Braze SME for campaign and customer journey implementation.
* Architect, build, review and optimize complex campaigns and lifecycle journeys using Braze.
* Provide technical and functional leadership across Braze Canvas/Campaigns, segmentation, personalization, dynamic content, Connected Content, APIs/webhooks and relevant integration capabilities.
* Guide the team on reusable, scalable and maintainable campaign/journey designs.
* Bring working knowledge of SFMC and/or Bird or any marketing platforms, particularly when supporting platform migrations or a multi-platform MarTech ecosystem.
* Evaluate new Braze capabilities and identify opportunities to improve campaign execution, personalization, automation and operational efficiency.

2. Campaign & Journey Management
  

* Lead end-to-end execution of sophisticated lifecycle and trigger-based campaigns across:

Email
  
SMS
  
Mobile Push / App
  
Cross-channel journeys
  

* Translate customer lifecycle and business requirements into executable campaign/journey designs.
* Design journeys covering customer onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, cross-sell/upsell, re-engagement and other lifecycle use cases.
* Drive segmentation and personalization strategies using custom attributes, behavioral data, transactional data and event-based triggers.
* Establish campaign QA, testing, approval and deployment processes.
* Review journey logic, entry/exit conditions, audience eligibility, suppression rules, frequency management and channel sequencing.
* Drive testing and optimization of campaigns through appropriate experimentation strategies.

3. Financial Services Domain
  

* Lead MarTech delivery for financial-services / banking / FinTech customer engagement programs.
* Understand customer lifecycle scenarios relevant to financial products and services.
* Work within the client's applicable privacy, consent, compliance and communication-governance requirements.
* Ensure campaign solutions correctly implement approved eligibility, suppression and customer-contact rules.
* Partner with business, compliance, data and technology stakeholders when campaign requirements depend on regulated or sensitive customer data.

4. Team Leadership & People Management
  

* Manage and mentor a 10+ member team comprising campaign specialists, MarTech developers/consultants and/or QA resources.
* Own day-to-day workload allocation, campaign pipeline management and delivery planning.
* Conduct regular campaign and solution reviews to ensure quality and consistency.
* Provide technical guidance and unblock delivery challenges.
* Develop Braze expertise within the team through coaching, knowledge sharing and implementation standards.
* Manage competing priorities, resource bandwidth, escalations and delivery dependencies.
* Establish clear ownership and accountability across campaigns and projects.

5. Client & Stakeholder Management
  

* Act as a key MarTech point of contact for client stakeholders.
* Lead client calls, campaign discussions, requirement-gathering workshops, solution reviews and delivery/status meetings.
* Translate business requirements into clear technical and campaign specifications for the delivery team.
* Provide recommendations to clients on campaign/journey design and marketing automation best practices.
* Communicate risks, dependencies, blockers and implementation considerations proactively.
* Coordinate with client-side Marketing, Product, Data, Analytics, Technology and other relevant stakeholders.
* Manage stakeholder expectations while maintaining delivery quality and timelines.

**Required Skills & Experience**
  

* 10+ years of overall experience in Marketing Technology, Marketing Automation, CRM, Campaign Operations or Lifecycle Marketing.
* Strong recent hands-on Braze experience, ideally leading enterprise-scale implementations.
* Demonstrated experience building complex Braze Canvas journeys and campaigns.
* Experience delivering campaigns across Email, SMS and Mobile App/Push channels.
* Strong understanding of:

Lifecycle marketing
  
Cross-channel orchestration
  
Customer segmentation
  
Personalization
  
Event/trigger-based campaigns
  
Dynamic content
  
Experimentation/testing
  
Campaign QA and deployment
  

* Experience managing a 10+ member delivery team.
* Strong client-facing experience, including requirements gathering, solution discussions and status/governance calls.

**Preferred Qualifications**
  

* Experience in Banking, Financial Services, FinTech or another regulated industry.
* Prior experience with other marketing platforms in addition to Braze.
* Experience transitioning marketing automation programs from Bird to Braze would be highly valuable.
* Understanding of marketing/customer data integration patterns.
* Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, event-based data, customer attributes and real-time campaign triggers.
* Experience running large-scale campaign operations and establishing campaign governance frameworks.
* Braze certifications or relevant marketing automation/platform certifications would be advantageous.

In this role, you will design, execute, and optimize multi-channel digital campaigns tailored for global healthcare executives, regulatory leaders, and medical devices across India, the US, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.

**What you'll do**

* **Google Ads Campaigns:**
* Build, structure, and scale high-intent B2B Google Analytics and Ads, Display, Remarketing, and Video campaigns to capture active search demand for MedTech and regulatory compliance solutions.
* Conduct thorough keyword research, query mining, match type refinement, and negative keyword management to ensure high relevance, identify the right audience and minimize wasted ad spend.
* Continuously test ad copy variations, responsive search ads (RSAs), extension assets, bid strategies (e.g., Target CPA, Maximize Conversions, CTR), and landing page experiences to drive lower Cost Per Acquisition (CPA) and higher conversion rates.
* **LinkedIn Ads & Account-Based Marketing (ABM):**
* Design and deploy targeted B2B campaigns using LinkedIn Campaign Manager, leveraging Sponsored Content, Lead Gen Forms, Message/InMail Ads, Static Ads and Dynamic Ads.

* **Experience:**

2-3 years of proven experience managing B2B digital marketing campaigns, preferably within a SaaS, B2B Tech, Healthcare/Life Sciences, or Professional Services environment.

* **Mandatory Technical & Digital Marketing Skills:**
* **Google Ads:** Hands-on mastery of Google Analytics and Ads, Display, Remarketing, and Video campaign setup, keyword strategies, bid management, and Conversion Tracking.

* **SEO:** Strong expertise in keyword research, technical SEO audits, site taxonomy, link-building strategies, and hands-on usage of tools like Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, and Google Search Console.
* **Analytics & Tracking:** Advanced proficiency in Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), UTM tracking parameters, and conversion attribution models.
* Business Intelligence & Data Visualization: Looker Studio (formerly Google Data Studio) / Microsoft Power BI
* **Core Competencies:**

* Strong analytical mind with the ability to turn complex marketing data into actionable growth strategies.

**Nice-to-haves**

* Prior exposure or background in B2B marketing for Healthcare, Medical Devices, Pharmaceuticals, or Regulatory Compliance industries.

1. **Staff Management**: Hiring, training, scheduling, and supervising farm workers or labourers to ensure efficient operation of the farm.

2. **Crop Planning and Management**: Developing crop rotation plans, selecting appropriate crops for planting, and managing planting, harvesting, and post-harvest activities.

3. **Livestock Care**: Ensuring the health and well-being of livestock, including feeding, watering, monitoring for illness, and coordinating with veterinarians as needed.

4. **Equipment Maintenance**: Maintaining farm equipment and machinery to ensure they are in good working condition. This includes scheduling regular maintenance and repairs as needed.

5. **Budgeting and Financial Management**: Developing and managing the farm budget, including monitoring expenses, tracking revenues, and making financial decisions to ensure the profitability of the farm.

6. **Marketing and Sales**: Identifying market opportunities for farm products, developing marketing strategies, and managing sales channels such as farmers' markets, CSA (Community Supported Agriculture) programs, or direct sales to restaurants and retailers.

7. **Environmental Stewardship**: Implementing sustainable farming practices to minimize environmental impact, conserve natural resources, and promote soil health and biodiversity.

8. **Compliance and Regulation**: Ensuring compliance with local, state, and federal regulations related to farming, food safety, labour, and environmental protection.

9. **Record Keeping**: Maintaining accurate records of farm activities, including crop yields, livestock inventory, financial transactions, and regulatory compliance documentation.

10. **Facility Management**: Managing farm buildings, infrastructure, and utilities to ensure they are well-maintained and operational.

11. **Pest and Disease Management**: Implementing integrated pest management strategies to control pests and diseases while minimizing the use of chemical pesticides.

12. **Community Relations**: Building positive relationships with neighbours, community organizations, and local authorities to foster goodwill and address any concerns related to the farm's operations.

13. **Emergency Response**: Developing and implementing emergency response plans to address situations such as severe weather, livestock emergencies, or equipment failures.

14. **Continued Learning and Professional Development**: Staying informed about advancements in farming techniques, technologies, and regulations through on-going education and professional development opportunities.

title: Engr III Spec-AI Science
description:
### **When you join Verizon**

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

We are looking for a highly skilled **Engineer III, AI Science** to design, build, and scale our next generation of AI systems. In this senior technical role, you will be a key driver in transitioning our machine learning capabilities from traditional predictive modeling to advanced Agentic and Prescriptive AI paradigms.

You will be hands-on in developing autonomous AI agents, large language model (LLM) pipelines, and reinforcement learning engines that optimize customer lifecycles, automate complex workflows, and drive measurable business value. You will also serve as a technical lead on high-impact projects, mentoring junior engineers and shaping our internal AI engineering standards.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Agentic AI & LLM Development**

* Design, build, and deploy multi-agent systems and autonomous workflows using modern frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI).
* Develop robust LLM-based applications capable of reasoning, tool-use, and executing complex, multi-step tasks for dynamic customer interactions and internal automation.
* Implement guardrails, evaluation frameworks (LLM-as-a-judge), and prompt-engineering best practices to ensure safe, reliable, and compliant agent behavior in production.

**2. Predictive & Prescriptive Modeling**

* Build state-of-the-art predictive models (deep learning, sequence models, tree-based models) for forecasting customer behavior, churn, propensity, and lifetime value (CLTV).
* Develop prescriptive optimization engines using Reinforcement Learning (RL), Contextual Bandits, or mathematical optimization to power real-time "Next Best Action" (NBA) and dynamic pricing recommendations.
* Apply causal inference and uplift modeling techniques to measure and optimize the true incremental impact of AI-driven interventions.

**3. Production Engineering & MLOps**

* Collaborate with MLOps and Data Engineering teams to deploy machine learning and agentic models into highly scalable, low-latency production environments.
* Write production-grade, optimized code (Python) and build robust API endpoints for AI service integration.
* Design and maintain telemetry for monitoring model drift, agent hallucination rates, and overall system performance.

**4. Technical Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead the end-to-end technical execution of complex AI projects, from ideation and prototyping to production deployment.
* Mentor Engineer I and II team members, conduct rigorous code/model reviews, and foster a culture of continuous learning.
* Partner closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and Business Stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI solutions.

### **Required Qualifications**

* **Education:** Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
* **Experience:** 5+ years of applied industry experience in machine learning, AI science, or data engineering (or 3+ years with a Ph.D.).
* **Technical Skills:**Advanced proficiency in **Python** and standard ML libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, XGBoost/LightGBM).Hands-on experience building and deploying **LLMs and Agentic AI** (LangChain, OpenAI APIs, open-source models like Llama 3/Mistral, RAG architectures).Strong foundation in **Predictive and Prescriptive ML** methodologies (time-series, reinforcement learning, optimization algorithms).Solid SQL skills and experience with big data processing (Spark, Databricks, Snowflake).
* **Engineering Best Practices:** Experience with cloud computing platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines for ML.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience building AI engines specifically for Base Management, Marketing Tech, or Customer Value Management (CVM).
* Experience with Causal Machine Learning (DoWhy, EconML).
* Active contributor to open-source AI projects or a portfolio demonstrating complex agentic workflow development.

### **Where you’ll be working**

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

### **Scheduled Weekly Hours**

40

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

**1. Design and Concept Development:**

* Conduct **site visits** to evaluate progress and ensure that tile designs are executed as per the approved plans.

* Gain in-depth knowledge of the company’s tile product portfolio, including materials, finishes, textures, and dimensions.
* Advise clients and internal teams on **tile selection** based on project requirements, such as durability, maintenance, and design compatibility.

* Present design concepts and tile solutions to clients, incorporating their feedback into revisions.
* Develop compelling **visual presentations** and mood boards to demonstrate the creative application of tiles.
* Collaborate with sales and marketing teams to support **client pitches** and design consultations.

**6. Quality Assurance:**

* Ensure that tile designs and installations meet **quality standards** in terms of alignment, grout lines, and overall finish.
* Identify and troubleshoot design or installation challenges during the project lifecycle.

We are looking for an experienced, creative, and results-driven Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Manager to lead the digital marketing initiatives and online business growth of our Gold and Silver Jewellery Retail Showroom.

title: Director 1, Software Development & Engineering
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.

**Job Summary**

This job is responsible for steering software development strategies that support the organization's goals. It involves setting coding standards, leading teams in the creation of innovative software, and managing ongoing support for existing platforms. Key duties include overseeing software releases, collaborating with managers on project delivery, and handling large-scale budgets. It also focuses on integrating new technologies to improve development practices and partnering cross-functionally to align with broader organizational objectives

**Job Description**

**Responsibilities**

* **Own end-to-end engineering delivery for Martech platforms**, including Digital Asset Management (DAM), Content Management System (CMS), Customer Data Platform (CDP), Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), and Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), ensuring scalability, performance, and resilience.
* **Drive integration across Adobe ecosystem and in-house platforms**, enabling unified customer profiles, real-time data activation, and omnichannel personalization.
* **Lead architecture and execution for omnichannel communications platforms**, including Email, SMS, Push Notifications, and RCS, ensuring consistent messaging experiences across channels.
* **Enable 1:1 personalized marketing and communications journeys** by leveraging CDP/AEP data pipelines and AJO orchestration capabilities.
* **Establish reusable services and APIs** to support content delivery, campaign orchestration, and cross-channel engagement.
* **Drive operational excellence for campaign execution platforms**, ensuring high availability, throughput, and compliance with privacy, PCI, and regulatory standards.
* **Partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Analytics teams** to translate business use cases into scalable platform capabilities and measurable outcomes.
* **Champion governance, data quality, and platform standards** across Martech and Communications systems to ensure consistency and long-term maintainability.
* **Lead modernization initiatives**, including migration to cloud-native architectures and adoption of AI/agentic capabilities to optimize customer engagement and campaign performance.
* Leading the development and execution of software strategies to align with organizational goals, **including Martech (DAM, CMS, CDP, AEP, AJO) and omnichannel communications platforms (Email, SMS, Push, RCS)**.
* Defining coding standards, architectural patterns, and reusable frameworks for application development across digital, Martech, and communications ecosystems.
* Directing a large team in creating innovative software and web applications, **including content platforms, customer data platforms, and engagement systems**, while ensuring ongoing support for existing solutions.
* Managing the rollout of software releases and updates across Martech and communications platforms, ensuring seamless implementation and minimal disruption to customer-facing experiences.
* Collaborating with managers and cross-functional partners (Marketing, Product, Analytics) to meet project deadlines, specifications, and budgetary constraints, while developing performance metrics tied to **customer engagement and platform adoption**.
* Reporting on project progress and managing large-scale budgets to meet financial targets, including investments across Martech and communications capabilities.
* Researching, evaluating, and integrating new technologies such as **Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), and emerging AI/agentic capabilities** to enhance development efficiency and personalization at scale.
* Driving integration across **Adobe ecosystem and in-house platforms** to enable unified customer profiles, real-time data activation, and 1:1 personalized experiences.
* Leading the architecture and execution of **omnichannel communication capabilities**, ensuring consistent, scalable delivery across Email, SMS, Push, and RCS channels.
* Establishing reusable services, APIs, and data pipelines to support **content delivery, campaign orchestration, and cross-channel engagement**.
* Driving operational excellence for campaign execution platforms, ensuring high availability, throughput, and compliance with **privacy, PCI, and regulatory standards**.
* Championing governance, data quality, and platform standards across Martech and communications systems to ensure scalability, consistency, and long-term maintainability.
* Partnering with other engineering teams to adopt practices and architectures that support broader organizational and platform transformation objectives.
* Leading modernization initiatives, including migration to **cloud-native architectures** and enabling **AI-driven customer engagement and personalization**.
* Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Regular, consistent and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) as necessary.
* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Employees at all levels are expected to:**

* Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
* Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.
* Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
* Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
* Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
* Drive results and growth.
* Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead.
* Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities.

Comcast is an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Comcast provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a Commission under the terms of an applicable plan, while most non-sales positions are eligible for a Bonus. Additionally, Comcast provides best-in-class Benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That’s why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality - to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. Please visit the compensation and benefits summary on our careers site for more details.

Bachelor's Degree

While possessing the stated degree is preferred, Comcast also may consider applicants who hold some combination of coursework and experience, or who have extensive related professional experience.

10 Years +

Job SummaryA Customer Relationship Executive (CRE) in a Co-operative Society is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with members and customers while driving business growth through effective sales, marketing, and direct sales activities. The role involves identifying and acquiring new customers, promoting and explaining the society’s products and services, including deposits, loans, savings schemes, and other financial products. The CRE acts as the first point of contact for customers, handles enquiries and complaints, provides timely assistance, and ensures a high level of customer satisfaction. The position requires regular field visits, direct customer meetings, lead generation, follow-ups, new customer acquisition, and achievement of assigned sales targets. The CRE is also responsible for promoting society schemes, maintaining proper documentation, following compliance and co-operative society procedures, and coordinating with internal teams for smooth service delivery. The role plays a key part in increasing business, expanding the customer base, strengthening member relationships, and contributing to the overall growth and development of the society.

Core Responsibilities

Ø Act as the primary point of contact for existing and prospective members/customers of the co-operative society.

Ø Identify and generate new business opportunities through **direct sales, field visits, referrals, lead generation, and customer meetings**.

Ø Acquire new customers and members by promoting the society’s deposits, loans, investment schemes, and other financial products.

Ø Build and maintain strong relationships with existing customers while continuously developing new customer networks.

Ø Achieve assigned **sales, customer acquisition, deposit, loan, and business development targets** within the stipulated timelines.

Ø Explain the features, benefits, eligibility, interest rates, terms, and conditions of society products clearly to customers.

Ø Follow up with leads, prospects, and existing customers through calls, visits, and other appropriate communication channels to ensure successful conversions.

Ø Collect and verify required customer documents and ensure proper KYC and other documentation as per company guidelines.

Ø Maintain accurate customer records, sales reports, lead details, follow-up records, and system entries on a timely basis.

description:
**MARKETING EXECUTIVE – JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Job description:**

The Field Marketing Representative plays a crucial role in driving brand visibility and sales for the corporate tiles industry by engaging with clients directly in the field. This role involves meeting prospective clients, promoting tiles and related products, conducting market surveys, and ensuring that customer requirements are met. The ideal candidate will be dynamic, self-motivated, and have excellent interpersonal skills, with a strong understanding of the tiles industry and market dynamics.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. On-field Client Engagement:**

* Visit prospective clients, including architects, builders, contractors, and retailers, to promote the company’s tiles and products.
* Build and nurture relationships with customers through regular follow-ups and on-site meetings.
* Address client inquiries and provide product demonstrations to explain features, benefits, and applications.

**2. Market Research and Analysis:**

* Conduct market surveys to identify new opportunities, trends, and competitor activities.
* Gather feedback from customers to understand their needs, preferences, and challenges.
* Provide detailed reports on market insights to the marketing and sales teams for strategy refinement.

**3. Product Promotion and Awareness:**

* Distribute marketing materials such as brochures, catalogues, and samples to potential clients.
* Educate customers on new product launches, offers, and promotions to drive interest and sales.

**4. Sales and Lead Conversion:**

* Identify and generate leads in the field, ensuring consistent follow-up to convert them into sales.
* Collaborate with the sales team to achieve individual and team sales targets.
* Negotiate pricing and terms with clients to close deals effectively.

**5. Reporting and Documentation:**

* Maintain accurate records of daily visits, client interactions, and sales activities.
* Prepare regular reports on field marketing activities, market trends, and sales performance.
* Use CRM tools or other systems to update client information and track progress.

**6. Coordination with Internal Teams:**

* Work closely with the marketing, sales, and logistics teams to ensure timely delivery and customer satisfaction.
* Communicate customer feedback and market requirements to the relevant departments for continuous improvement.

**Qualifications:**

* **Bachelor’s degree** in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred).
* **1-3 years of experience** in field marketing, sales, or business development.
* Knowledge of tiles, their features, and applications is highly advantageous.

**Key Skills:**

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to engage with clients and build relationships.
* Strong persuasion and negotiation skills to convert leads into sales.
* Analytical and problem-solving abilities to understand market trends and client needs.
* Proficiency in using CRM software, Microsoft Office, and other reporting tools.
* Organizational skills to manage schedules, client visits, and reporting effectively.

**Working Conditions:**

* Majority of work will be field-based, involving travel to client sites, project locations, and events.
* Flexible working hours, including evenings or weekends, as per client requirements.
* Regular interaction with clients and coordination with internal teams.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
* Travel and communication allowances.
* Health insurance and other benefits.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.

title: AI-Powered Digital Content & Social Media Marketing Specialist
description:
**Job Description: AI-Powered Digital Content & Social Media Marketing Specialist**

**Department:** Marketing  
**Designation:** AI-Powered Digital Content & Social Media Marketing Specialist  
**Experience:** 2–4 years preferred  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**1. Job Summary**

We are looking for a creative, hands-on, AI-enabled Digital Content & Social Media Marketing Specialist to strengthen brand visibility, audience engagement, and digital marketing performance across social media platforms.

The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end content production, including video shooting, video editing, graphic design, creative content development, social media scheduling, organic promotion, paid campaign coordination, and performance reporting.

The role requires someone who can transform business updates, product information, industry insights, expert inputs, and internal marketing materials into engaging digital content using a combination of creative skills, AI tools, and data-driven marketing practices.

The candidate must be comfortable coordinating with internal teams, subject-matter experts, and management to collect information, obtain approvals, maintain consistent brand messaging, and deliver content that supports business and marketing objectives.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Video Shooting & Production — Primary Responsibility**

* Plan, shoot, and produce short-form and long-form videos for social media, websites, campaigns, and business promotions.
* Independently handle video shooting using smartphones, cameras, microphones, lighting equipment, and other available production tools.
* Record interviews, expert discussions, product demonstrations, company updates, educational videos, behind-the-scenes content, and promotional videos.
* Plan video concepts, scripts, storyboards, shot lists, and production schedules.
* Edit videos with appropriate cuts, subtitles, captions, transitions, graphics, voiceovers, music, and brand elements.
* Create platform-specific video formats, including vertical short-form videos, reels, shorts, and landscape videos.
* Use AI-assisted video tools for captioning, transcription, background cleanup, audio enhancement, translation, resizing, and editing efficiency.
* Ensure videos are technically sound, visually appealing, factually accurate, and consistent with the approved brand identity.
* Maintain an organised library of raw footage, edited videos, source files, and approved final assets.

**B. Graphic Design & Creative Content Production**

* Design social media posts, carousels, infographics, promotional creatives, banners, thumbnails, event creatives, and campaign materials.
* Convert internal documents, product information, research findings, testimonials, case studies, and expert insights into visually engaging marketing assets.
* Create graphics that simplify technical, scientific, and business information for relevant audiences.
* Use design tools such as Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, or equivalent applications.
* Use AI-assisted design tools to generate creative concepts, visual variations, layouts, and supporting assets.
* Verify all AI-generated visuals and text for accuracy, licensing considerations, brand suitability, and misleading representations.
* Maintain consistent typography, colour palettes, logos, visual styles, and messaging across channels.
* Prepare multiple creative formats and dimensions for different platforms.

**C. AI-Powered Content Creation**

* Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and suitable image, audio, and video tools to support ideation, scripting, editing, repurposing, and campaign development.
* Develop video scripts, hooks, headlines, captions, calls to action, hashtags, and content variations.
* Repurpose a single approved source into multiple assets, such as a video, carousel, infographic, LinkedIn post, newsletter visual, and short-form clip.
* Create AI-assisted content workflows and reusable prompts to improve productivity without compromising quality.
* Fact-check claims, statistics, technical statements, testimonials, and AI-generated information before publication.
* Ensure content is original, audience-focused, natural, and aligned with the organisation's expertise and positioning.
* Avoid fabricated customer stories, misleading synthetic visuals, unverified claims, and unauthorised use of personal likenesses or voices.

**D. Social Media Content Planning & Scheduling**

* Develop and maintain a monthly social media content calendar aligned with marketing priorities, campaigns, launches, events, and industry developments.
* Plan content themes, formats, publication dates, channels, target audiences, and calls to action.
* Schedule and publish approved content across relevant platforms, including LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and other business-relevant channels.
* Coordinate with internal teams to collect updates, footage, product information, expert inputs, and campaign requirements.
* Ensure all posts follow brand guidelines, platform specifications, and internal approval procedures.
* Maintain a publishing tracker containing content status, approval records, scheduled dates, live URLs, and performance results.
* Ensure consistent posting while prioritising quality, relevance, and audience needs.

**E. Social Media Promotion & Audience Engagement**

* Promote published content through appropriate organic distribution strategies and relevant professional communities.
* Identify suitable industry groups, partner pages, expert networks, and audience segments for legitimate content distribution.
* Coordinate approved paid social campaigns with the marketing lead when required.
* Monitor comments, shares, messages, mentions, and audience feedback.
* Respond to routine audience interactions within approved communication guidelines and escalate business enquiries, complaints, or sensitive issues to the relevant team.
* Encourage meaningful engagement through educational content, expert perspectives, interactive posts, polls, and question-led formats.
* Coordinate with internal teams to amplify relevant company updates and approved campaigns.
* Avoid fake engagement, automated spam, purchased followers, and misleading engagement tactics.

**F. Platform-Specific Content Strategy**

* **LinkedIn:** Develop professional posts, industry insights, expert clips, company updates, carousels, thought-leadership content, and B2B campaign assets.
* **Instagram:** Create reels, stories, carousels, behind-the-scenes videos, and visually engaging educational content where relevant.
* **YouTube:** Produce educational videos, expert interviews, explainers, product demonstrations, and Shorts.
* **Other relevant channels:** Adapt content to audience behaviour and business objectives rather than publishing identical content everywhere.
* Optimise captions, titles, thumbnails, descriptions, hashtags, and calls to action according to platform best practices.

**G. Social Media Analytics & Engagement Reporting**

* Track content performance using native platform analytics and relevant reporting tools.
* Monitor reach, impressions, views, watch time, average viewing duration, completion rate, engagement rate, shares, saves, comments, profile visits, link clicks, and audience growth where available.
* Track website traffic, leads, enquiries, and conversions attributable to social campaigns where measurement is available.
* Identify top-performing content, underperforming formats, audience preferences, and opportunities for improvement.
* Conduct regular reviews of posting times, creative formats, hooks, video lengths, and calls to action.
* Prepare weekly and monthly reports with screenshots, live URLs, metrics, comparisons, insights, and recommended actions.
* Distinguish organic performance from paid campaign results and report the measurement period and platform accurately.
* Use performance insights to refine the next content calendar and improve engagement quality over time.

**H. Internal Coordination & Brand Governance**

* Coordinate with Business Development, Sales, Product, Research, Quality, Regulatory, and Operations teams to collect content inputs.
* Obtain testimonials, case studies, expert commentary, product updates, customer insights, and event materials.
* Convert the collected inputs into publication-ready visual and video content.
* Obtain management approval before publishing external content, following the organisation's established approval process.
* Ensure brand positioning, terminology, claims, and visual identity remain consistent.
* Obtain consent and necessary permissions before publishing customer testimonials, interviews, identifiable individuals, or confidential business information.
* Maintain records of source materials, approvals, final creatives, publication links, and performance reports.

**3. Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or relevant qualification in Digital Marketing, Visual Communication, Multimedia, Mass Communication, Marketing, or a related field.
* 2–4 years of relevant experience in digital content production and social media marketing, preferably supported by a portfolio.
* Hands-on video shooting, editing, graphic design, and creative content production skills.
* Practical experience with Canva, CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Photoshop, or equivalent tools.
* Working knowledge of AI tools for content creation, video editing, design assistance, transcription, and creative ideation.
* Experience managing content calendars, scheduling posts, and publishing across multiple platforms.
* Understanding of social media analytics, engagement metrics, audience behaviour, and content optimisation.
* Strong visual storytelling, writing, communication, and coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently from content planning through production, publishing, and reporting.
* Good organisational skills and the ability to meet publishing schedules.

**4. Preferred Skills**

* Experience with B2B, SaaS, manufacturing, food, nutraceuticals, cosmetics, scientific, or technology brands.
* Experience filming professional interviews and creating educational or technical videos.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn analytics, YouTube Studio, Meta Business Suite, and scheduling tools.
* Understanding of AI-assisted video generation, synthetic voice tools, automated captioning, and creative automation.
* Familiarity with UTM links, website analytics, campaign tracking, and lead attribution.
* Experience supporting paid social campaigns and optimising content based on performance data.

Specific monthly targets should be established after assessing available resources, existing audience size, platform baselines, and campaign priorities. Success should not be measured by follower count or post volume alone.

description:
**Job Description: AI Content Marketing & Thought Leadership Specialist**

**Department:** Marketing  
**Designation:** AI Content Marketing & Thought Leadership Specialist  
**Experience:** 2–4 years preferred  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**1. Job Summary**

We are seeking an AI-aware Content Marketing & Thought Leadership Specialist to develop high-quality marketing content, strengthen brand positioning, and improve visibility across traditional search engines and AI-powered search platforms.

The candidate will coordinate with internal teams, industry experts, and subject-matter specialists to collect business information, customer testimonials, case studies, product insights, research inputs, and technical information. These inputs must be transformed into clear, engaging, fact-checked, and approved marketing materials.

The role involves industrial article writing, expert interviews, email newsletters, LinkedIn content, AI search visibility monitoring, brand messaging consistency, content reporting, and preparation of authoritative brand information for appropriate online platforms.

The ideal candidate should combine excellent writing and reporting skills with practical knowledge of AI-assisted content workflows, SEO, and emerging AI search and answer engines.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Internal Marketing Coordination & Content Development**

* Coordinate with internal teams, including Business Development, Sales, Product, Research, Quality, Regulatory, and Operations, to collect marketing information and supporting materials.
* Obtain customer testimonials, case studies, success stories, product information, technical insights, research findings, and business updates.
* Convert internal inputs into usable marketing assets, including website content, articles, brochures, newsletters, social media posts, presentations, and sales-support materials.
* Conduct follow-ups with responsible team members to obtain missing information, supporting documents, evidence, and approvals.
* Maintain a structured content repository containing source materials, drafts, approved versions, publication links, and supporting references.
* Ensure all marketing materials are reviewed and approved by the designated authority before publication.

**B. AI-Assisted Content Creation & Quality Assurance**

* Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and other relevant platforms for research assistance, content structuring, drafting, editing, summarization, and content repurposing.
* Convert technical and industry-specific information into accurate, readable, audience-appropriate content.
* Develop reusable AI prompts, content templates, and workflows to improve productivity and consistency.
* Fact-check AI-generated content against reliable sources and approved company information.
* Verify statistics, scientific claims, quotations, references, and regulatory statements before publication.
* Ensure AI-generated content is original, useful, natural, and aligned with the brand's expertise and tone.
* Avoid fabricated testimonials, unsupported claims, invented citations, and unverified AI-generated answers.
* Maintain records of source materials, fact-checking, editorial reviews, and content approvals.

**C. Industrial Articles & External Publications**

* Research and write articles for relevant industrial magazines, trade publications, industry portals, and professional publications.
* Identify suitable publications and prepare content pitches, article proposals, author profiles, and submission emails.
* Coordinate with subject-matter experts to obtain technical inputs, industry perspectives, and supporting evidence.
* Translate expert knowledge into authoritative articles, explainers, opinion pieces, and thought-leadership content.
* Track editorial submissions, acceptance status, revisions, publication dates, and published links.
* Ensure that external articles meet the publication's editorial guidelines and preserve the company's approved positioning.

**D. Expert Coordination & Interviews**

* Identify relevant internal and external experts for interviews, expert commentary, technical articles, and thought-leadership campaigns.
* Coordinate interview schedules, prepare interview questions, collect background information, and manage follow-ups.
* Convert interviews, transcripts, and expert inputs into articles, Q&A features, newsletters, LinkedIn posts, and website content.
* Obtain expert review and approval for technical accuracy and publication consent where required.
* Maintain an expert database containing areas of expertise, interview records, approved quotations, and content opportunities.

**E. Email Newsletter Development**

* Plan and prepare periodic email newsletters for relevant audiences, including industry stakeholders, customers, partners, and professional networks.
* Collect approved updates from internal teams and convert them into concise, useful newsletter content.
* Develop newsletter subject lines, headlines, summaries, calls to action, and supporting links.
* Coordinate review, approval, scheduling, and distribution with the responsible marketing or email operations team.
* Monitor delivery, open rates, click-through rates, engagement, and other available performance metrics.
* Maintain consistent messaging and ensure mailing practices follow applicable privacy and consent requirements.

**F. LinkedIn & Brand Communication**

* Prepare and manage a content calendar for LinkedIn and other approved professional channels.
* Create posts, industry insights, article summaries, expert quotations, company updates, case-study highlights, and campaign content.
* Repurpose approved long-form content into short-form posts, carousels, newsletters, and other suitable formats.
* Coordinate with internal teams to obtain relevant updates, visuals, data, and approvals.
* Maintain consistent brand voice, terminology, positioning, and visual-content coordination.
* Monitor engagement and use performance insights to improve future content.

**G. AI Search Visibility & Answer Engine Optimization (AEO/GEO)**

* Monitor the brand's visibility and representation across AI-powered search and answer platforms, where measurable.
* Track relevant industry keywords, brand mentions, citations, source references, and the accuracy of AI-generated answers.
* Develop content that clearly answers relevant industry questions and demonstrates expertise, experience, authority, and trustworthiness.
* Create question-led articles, FAQs, expert explainers, comparison content, and evidence-backed educational resources.
* Improve content structure, factual clarity, source attribution, and entity consistency to support discoverability in traditional search and AI-generated answers.
* Record representative AI-generated answers for selected queries, identify missing or inaccurate brand information, and recommend corrective content improvements.
* Monitor conventional SEO performance through Google Search Console and other available analytics tools.
* Prepare periodic AI visibility reports using a consistent set of prompts, queries, platforms, and observation dates.

**Important:** AI answer visibility can fluctuate and cannot be guaranteed. Reporting should distinguish observed mentions and citations from estimated visibility, and should not treat a single AI response as proof of ranking or authority.

**H. Keyword & Content Performance Monitoring**

* Maintain a keyword and topic tracker covering target keywords, search intent, content status, rankings, and visibility trends.
* Identify content gaps and new opportunities through keyword research, competitor analysis, industry questions, and customer-facing team inputs.
* Monitor keyword rankings, organic impressions, clicks, engagement, referrals, and conversions where measurable.
* Review content performance regularly and recommend updates, new articles, or content consolidation where appropriate.
* Prepare actionable reports highlighting progress, gaps, risks, and next steps.

**I. Wikipedia & Authoritative Brand Information**

* Prepare factual, neutral, well-sourced company or industry background write-ups for editorial review and potential use on appropriate knowledge platforms.
* Research reliable independent sources, published coverage, verifiable company information, and relevant industry references.
* Draft encyclopedic-style content that follows the relevant platform's notability, neutrality, sourcing, and conflict-of-interest policies.
* Distinguish independently published sources from company-owned materials and press releases.
* Coordinate transparent, policy-compliant submissions or edit suggestions where appropriate.
* Maintain accurate company descriptions and consistent brand facts across approved business profiles and public information sources.

**Wikipedia compliance:** Creating a write-up does not guarantee that a Wikipedia article will be accepted or retained. The candidate must not create promotional or unsupported content, disguise a conflict of interest, or promise a Wikipedia page as a deliverable.

**J. Reporting, Documentation & Content Operations**

* Prepare weekly and monthly marketing content reports with measurable outputs and outcomes.
* Maintain trackers for content requests, source-material collection, drafting, review, approval, publication, and performance.
* Report the number of assets created, articles submitted and published, expert interviews completed, newsletters delivered, and LinkedIn posts published.
* Maintain evidence of published work, URLs, campaign results, approvals, and source references.
* Prepare management-ready summaries, dashboards, and presentations.
* Highlight pending inputs, approval delays, content gaps, and recommended priorities.
* Ensure that every reported activity is traceable to a document, published link, tracker entry, or analytics source.

**3. Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Marketing, Life Sciences, Food Science, Biotechnology, or a related discipline.
* Strong written English, editing, proofreading, research, and documentation skills.
* Practical experience using AI tools for research assistance and content development.
* Knowledge of SEO, keyword research, content optimization, and AI search visibility concepts.
* Ability to coordinate professionally with internal teams, industry experts, and external publications.
* Strong reporting, spreadsheet, presentation, and documentation skills.
* Ability to understand technical or scientific information and communicate it accurately to business audiences.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn content, email newsletters, editorial submissions, and content calendars.
* High attention to detail, fact-checking, source verification, and approval processes.

**4. Preferred Skills**

* Experience in B2B, SaaS, scientific, manufacturing, food, nutraceutical, cosmetics, healthcare, or regulatory-focused industries.
* Experience contributing articles to trade magazines or professional publications.
* Familiarity with ChatGPT, Claude, Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Ahrefs, Semrush, or equivalent tools.
* Experience preparing case studies, customer stories, expert interviews, and executive thought-leadership content.
* Understanding of Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and AI search monitoring.
* Experience with newsletter tools, editorial calendars, and content performance dashboards.

**5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance should be assessed on both output quality and measurable results.

* **Content coordination:** Timely collection of required inputs from internal teams and experts.
* **Content production:** Number of approved articles, newsletters, LinkedIn posts, case studies, and other marketing assets completed.
* **Publication outcomes:** Articles pitched, accepted, published, and linked to verifiable publication evidence.
* **Expert engagement:** Interviews coordinated and approved expert contributions converted into content.
* **AI content quality:** Accuracy, originality, source verification, and approval compliance.
* **SEO performance:** Target keyword coverage, organic impressions, clicks, and relevant ranking trends.
* **AI search monitoring:** Completed prompt/query checks, observed brand mentions, citations, and documented improvement opportunities.
* **Brand consistency:** Compliance with approved positioning, terminology, tone, and messaging.
* **Reporting:** Timely submission of accurate weekly and monthly reports.
* **Process compliance:** Proper documentation, traceability, and approval before external publication.

Targets should be finalized after reviewing the existing content pipeline, available expert inputs, publication opportunities, and marketing resources.

title: Regional Medical Advisor- Derma
description:
**Company Description**  

Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because **Good Health Can’t Wait**.


We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.


For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).


‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose\-driven, future\-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1\.5 Bn\+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency


Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ \& nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

 **Job Description** **Job Summary**  

We are looking for the Primary scientific face of the organization to ‘Thought Leaders’ \& physicians for a given therapy area. You will be responsible for Identification, mapping and profiling of thought leaders of given geography and therapy area, on an ongoing basis.  

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**  

* You will be responsible for the engagement of identified key thought leaders through medical affairs activities, in alignment with the overall strategic plan
* You will be responsible to execution of strategic medical affairs plan including but not limited to medical education, product education, medical evidence generation, advisory boards, pre\-license activities and special projects
* You will be a therapeutic area scientific expert, responsible for discussing the scientific data pertaining to products on proactive and reactive basis, patients’ treatment trends and studies in the therapeutic areas in which the Company is involved, with defined audience of leading specialists (Physicians, Pharmacists, Hospital Managers, Board Members of Scientific Societies, and other Stakeholders) and to be considered a trusted scientific counterpart
* You will be responsible with therapy area lead to support optimal patient outcomes through communication of data, information, knowledge and insights in support of healthcare professional needs and organizational goals
* You will have to represent the organization in various internal \& external scientific platforms
* You will have to gather deep insights on disease trends and treatment patterns from key thought leaders and conveying them back to the therapy lead and commercial teams.
* You will need to proactively conduct disease trend analysis in identified disease segments and contribute effectively to the development of annual Medical Affairs Strategy Plan
* You will be receiving and processing scientific information requests received from physicians
* You will have to ensure that all activities in the region are conducted in alignment to organisation’s COBE (Code of Business Ethics) Policy and compliance guidelines.
* You will need to collaborate with thought leaders to conduct therapy specific reviews, meta\-analysis, case studies, case series, patient reported outcomes and publish them in reputed journals.
* You will be responsible for devising an optimal training plan to ensure the flow of the latest medical developments to the sales and marketing teams.
* You will jointly be responsible with the therapy area lead to support optimal patient outcomes through communication of data, information, knowledge, and insights in support of healthcare professional needs and organizational goals.
* Representing the organization in various internal and external scientific platforms will be among your responsibilities.
* You will be responsible for developing the Medical Affairs strategic plan for identified therapeutic areas and products.
* Your ability to convert insights on disease trends and treatment patterns from key thought leaders into viable and formidable strategic plans to shape the therapeutic areas of interest will be vital.
* You will be responsible for identifying knowledge gaps, practice gaps, and data gaps and developing strategic medical action plans, including but not limited to medical education, product education, evidence generation, and special projects, will fall under your responsibility.
* Collaborating with thought leaders to conduct therapy\-specific reviews, meta\-analysis, case studies, case series, patient\-reported outcomes, and publishing them in reputable journals will be part of your role.
* Handling complex questions from healthcare professionals related to GGI products or disease areas to satisfaction will be a key responsibility.
* You will be responsible for ensuring that all activities in the therapeutic area are conducted in alignment with Dr. Reddy's COBE (Code of Business Ethics) Policy and compliance guidelines will be essential.
* You will be responsible for ensuring that all promotional, physician, and patient education materials are approved within stipulated timelines and in alignment with Dr. Reddy's Promotional Material approval policy.
* As a product pipeline champion, you will have the ability to identify unmet needs through active stakeholder interactions and actively contribute to the new product ideation and development of differentiated products.

  

  

  

**Qualifications** **Educational Qualification\-** MBBS with full time post\-graduate qualification of at least 2\-years’ duration in any discipline of medicine/ M.B.B.S with M.B.A. from a reputed institute  

  

**Minimum work experience\-** Fresh postgraduate or up to 2 years of experience in Field based Medical Affairs.  

  

**Skills \& attributes –**  

**Technical Skills**  

* Strong academic record with deep knowledge of the therapeutic area, strength in research with knowledge of research methodologies and interpretation of medical data
* Experience with scientific acumen and communication skills in order to be accepted by leading specialists in peer\-to\-peer relationship
* Experience with complex business environments preferred
* Strong track record of success as demonstrated through annual performance ratings and/or professional accomplishments and awards.

You'll lead a team of marketing professionals and work closely with business stakeholders, sales, content, design, and digital marketing teams to deliver measurable marketing outcomes.


**What You'll Do**

  

  

As a **Marketing Manager** at LevelShift, you will:


* Lead and manage a team of **Content Writers and Marketing Executives** to achieve campaign objectives and business targets.
* Own and execute the **marketing calendar and campaign plan** in alignment with organizational and business priorities.
* Plan, coordinate, and monitor integrated **B2B marketing campaigns** across email, social media, PPC, SEO/AEO, content marketing, and publications.
* Drive end\-to\-end campaign execution, including **campaign planning, content development, creative coordination, publishing, promotion, performance tracking, and optimization**.
* Review campaign performance regularly and drive **course corrections based on campaign data, engagement, lead quality, and conversion trends**.
* Partner with the **design team** to develop campaign creatives, marketing collateral, digital assets, and content required for campaign execution.
* Work closely with the **digital marketing team** to drive SEO/AEO, paid marketing, website optimization, and digital campaign performance.
* Own and manage the **content calendar**, ensuring timely development and publication of high\-quality in\-house and outsourced content.
* Monitor and maintain **websites, social media channels, landing pages, and other digital marketing assets**.
* Lead and guide the **lead generation team** in identifying relevant target accounts, prospects, and contacts for various campaigns.
* Establish campaign objectives, monitor KPIs, analyze performance, and identify opportunities to improve **marketing effectiveness and ROI**.
* Work closely with **sales and business stakeholders** to understand business priorities and align marketing campaigns with lead\-generation and pipeline objectives.
* Manage multiple marketing initiatives simultaneously while ensuring **quality, timelines, and campaign deliverables** are met.
* Establish and maintain marketing processes, quality standards, and operating practices across the team.
* Track and review team activities, campaign progress, and individual performance against defined targets.
* Conduct regular **team meetings, performance reviews, feedback sessions, and best\-practice discussions**.
* Mentor and develop team members through **performance improvement, capability building, and continuous learning**.
* Provide floor support and respond to **prospect enquiries** when required.
* Monitor team engagement and take proactive measures to support **employee retention and team stability**.
* Prepare and present regular **marketing performance, campaign, lead\-generation, and team status reports** to the reporting manager.
* Identify and implement **process improvements** to enhance marketing efficiency, campaign execution, and overall team productivity.
* Ensure compliance with applicable **information security policies, organizational processes, and quality standards**.
  

  

**How This Role Uses AI**

* Utilize AI\-assisted tools for **content creation, campaign ideation, SEO/AEO optimization, audience research, lead generation, personalization, reporting, and campaign analysis**.
